title: Bearer Token Verifier Contract
description: Canonical contract for verifying bearer tokens issued by an external OIDC provider (e.g. the platform's shared Keycloak) and normalizing them into a platform-neutral Principal. This is the contract every backend-core stack projection (Go golang/auth, Python hideakisolutions_platform.auth, Node/TS auth) already implements in practice. It was previously undocumented at the platform-core level — the pre-existing, still-valid middleware-config shape lives in backend-core/security/contracts/auth-middleware.schema.json (backend-core/security/auth-middleware); middleware_config below mirrors it field-for-field so platform-core/auth is a complete, self-contained source of truth without requiring a cross-repo $ref. See docs/intents/0001-auth-authorization-bridge.md for why this was added.

middleware_config.description: Bearer verification middleware configuration. Field-for-field mirror of backend-core/security/auth-middleware#properties.authentication.

jwks_uri.description: Prefer an internal cluster JWKS URL over the public issuer for in-cluster token validation — decouples startup from external DNS/ingress reachability.

verify.description: The verify(token) operation every stack projection implements (e.g. Go Verifier.Verify, Python/Node equivalents).

output.description: The normalized Principal returned on successful verification. Field names match the existing Go/Python/Node projections verbatim — this documents them, it does not introduce new ones.

tenant_id.description: Normalized from the configured tenant claim (default `tenant_id`).

roles.description: Normalized from Keycloak realm_access.roles. RBAC input for platform-core/authorization/decision#properties.request.properties.subject.properties.roles.

scopes.description: Space-delimited OAuth `scope` claim, split into an array.
